name: Commander.js
prompt:
In this folder, set up a small Node.js project (ES modules) that uses Commander.js for a command-line tool. Create `solution.mjs` that exports `buildProgram()`, which returns a new Commander program (do not parse `process.argv` in that file) named `hello` with:

1. A subcommand `greet <name>` with options `--shout` (uppercase the greeting) and `--times <n>` (how many times to print it, a positive integer, default 1). The action prints `Hello, <name>!` with `console.log` once per time. `--times` must be validated by Commander itself: a value like `abc` or `0` must make Commander report an invalid-argument error.
2. A `--version` flag that prints `1.2.3`.

Also add `cli.mjs` that runs `buildProgram().parse()`. Install the dependencies with npm.
